Webhooks often drive deployments. Without a signing secret anyone can forge an event; without TLS verification the payload (and anything it triggers) can be intercepted or altered.

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | Medium |
| Confidence | high |
| CWE | [CWE-345](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html), [CWE-295](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/295.html) |
| Command | `vulnetix gha settings`, `vulnetix gha audit` |
| Needs | webhooks. Without them the rule is reported as not evaluated, never as passed. |

## Remediation

Set a webhook secret and verify X-Hub-Signature-256 on receipt; enable SSL verification.

## Run only this rule

```sh
vulnetix gha settings --rule VNX-GH-216
```

## Scoring

CWSS vector at the rule's default severity: `CWSS:1.0/TI:M/AP:A/AL:A/IC:N/FC:LT/RP:N/RL:A/AV:I/AS:N/IN:A/SC:A/BI:M/DI:M/EX:M/EC:N/P:W`. A finding whose severity the repository's settings moved is scored at its adjusted severity.
